newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-STUTTGART LOSE GROUND AFTER DISAPPOINTING DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STUTTGART LOSE GROUND AFTER DISAPPOINTING DRAW.

text.p: VfB Stuttgart lost vital ground in the tight German league title race when they could only manage a 1-1 draw at bottom club Freiburg on Sunday.
Fourth-placed Stuttgart, who were without Brazilian striker Giovane Elber, struggled to find the net against a team who looked doomed to second division football next season.
Stuttgart are now six points behind leaders Bayern Munich who stretched their lead at the top with a 3-0 win at Hamburg on Saturday.
Champions Borussia Dortmund, who warmed up for their midweek European Cup semifinal with Manchester United by beating Bochum 2-0 at home on Saturday, are second, three points behind.
Bayer Leverkusen are a further two points back in third, one point ahead of Stuttgart.
